title: Production jobs, router và budgets
scope_items: Database Migration 00017: Created assets, generation_jobs, continuity_violations, file_uploads, and video_edit_jobs tables with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), foreign keys to workspaces, scripts, character_packs, and assets, explicit decimal money types (DB-H-001), and narrow role-based grants; reversible transactional down migration verified.

Acceptance Target 1 (Cancel/timeout/unknown-result recovery): Automatic and operator-driven cancellation semantics with terminal state enforcement, uncredited job refunds when in-flight jobs are cancelled prior to rendering, timeout polling watchdog with idempotent retry capability, and unknown-result reconciliation without double-charging or orphaned generation processes.

Acceptance Target 2 (Fallback no double charge): Pipeline router implements ordered provider fallback (Veo primary -> Kling secondary) with single-charge debit semantics. Quota reservations are only committed once per asset creation, and fallback attempts reuse the existing credit reservation without second debit.

Acceptance Target 3 (Budget preview and partial batch input validation): Bounded credit quote calculation before generation with exact decimal arithmetic (DB-H-001). Batch requests are validated row-by-row: invalid items are flagged with specific errors while valid items receive precise credit estimates and proceed independently without blocking the entire batch.

Acceptance Target 4 (FFmpeg/ffprobe argument allowlist, process-tree isolation and output validation): Subprocess executor validates arguments against an explicit allowlist (rejecting semicolons, pipes, shell metacharacters, file protocols, and unauthorized flags). Limits worker CPU time, memory (RLIMIT_AS), output size, and wall-clock execution with process-group killpg cleanup. Generated outputs are validated for existence, non-zero file size, and header probe before marking completed.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_CancelTimeoutAndUnknownRecovery (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter widget tests confirm cancellation refunds, terminal state transitions, and retry behavior.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_FallbackNoDoubleCharge (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter tests confirm seamless provider fallback from primary to secondary adapter with exactly one debit.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_BudgetPreviewAndPartialBatchValidation (Go -race), Vitest batch validator tests, and Flutter budget modal tests confirm item-level validation and bounded credit calculation.

Acceptance Target 4 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget4_FFmpegAllowlistResourceLimitsAndProcessKill (Go -race), command-line sanitization, CPU/memory limit enforcement, process group killing on cancel, and output verification.
Migration 00017 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 17 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check 0/0, vite build, 165 tests across 20 test files), check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /studio and /studio/queue), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze 0 issues, 142 tests passing) all pass.
external_gates: Production video generation models (Google Veo, Kling AI, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen-3) require production API credentials and live billing accounts. Mock provider adapters with realistic latencies, simulated failures, and error responses verified locally.
Production Clerk instance and webhook signing credentials for live multi-tenant JWT validation.

Migration 00017 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
